before.title: CAR T-cell immunotherapy plus verdinexor for canine glioma
before.center: Colorado State University Veterinary Teaching Hospital
before.funding: 🟢 Fully funded. CSU states that CAR T-cell production and treatment, optional radiation therapy, MRIs, study examinations and bloodwork, and lifetime verdinexor chemotherapy are covered.
before.notes: CSU protocol IACUC 5335 enrolls dogs over 10 lb with a presumptive or confirmed glioma. The protocol combines autologous engineered CAR T cells with oral verdinexor; radiation therapy is optional. Dogs may not have received prior chemotherapy or radiation. CSU lists recruitment through December 31, 2028; final neurologic and anesthesia eligibility requires study-team prescreening.

sites.hospital: Colorado State University Veterinary Teaching Hospital
sites.name: Colorado State University Veterinary Teaching Hospital

before.special_requirement: Glioma must be confirmed on MRI; a brain biopsy is case-dependent rather than required for every patient. Anesthesia suitability, CAR-T treatment, home verdinexor and radiation-study requirements need CSU review. Prior chemotherapy or radiation is excluded.

before.title: Pilot clinical trial of trametinib treatment in dogs with acute myeloid leukemia (AML)
before.center: Colorado State University Flint Animal Cancer Center
before.status: Actively recruiting — listed on CSU current clinical trials page
before.contacts: CSU Flint Animal Cancer Center Clinical Trials — (970) 297-4001; online clinical-trial consult form
before.funding: 🟡 Partially funded. Study trametinib and prednisone, study-related diagnostic monitoring and sample shipping are covered. The source does not state that initial leukemia diagnosis or unrelated care is covered; confirm the individual owner estimate with CSU.
before.notes: Pilot anti-cancer treatment study of trametinib in naturally occurring canine acute myeloid leukemia. Full protocol eligibility requires CSU prescreening.
before.special_requirement: Confirmed AML with circulating leukemia cells, adequate activity/organ function and completion of previous chemotherapy washout; concurrent other anticancer treatment is excluded.

after.title: Pilot clinical trial of trametinib treatment in dogs with acute myeloid leukemia (AML)
after.center: Colorado State University Flint Animal Cancer Center
after.status: Actively recruiting — listed on CSU current clinical trials page
after.contacts: CSU Flint Animal Cancer Center Clinical Trials — (970) 297-4001; online clinical-trial consult form
after.funding: 🟡 Partially funded. Study trametinib and prednisone, study-related diagnostic monitoring and sample shipping are covered. The source does not state that initial leukemia diagnosis or unrelated care is covered; confirm the individual owner estimate with CSU.
after.notes: CSU-coordinated pilot treatment study of trametinib plus prednisone for confirmed canine acute myeloid leukemia with circulating leukemia cells. All study visits take place with the pet’s local oncologist; travel to CSU is not required. Study medication, diagnostic monitoring and sample shipping are covered; initial diagnosis and unrelated care are not stated to be covered. Previous anticancer treatment requires investigator-defined washout; serious incompatible organ disease excludes participation.
after.special_requirement: Confirmed AML with circulating leukemia cells, adequate activity/organ function and completion of previous chemotherapy washout; concurrent other anticancer treatment is excluded.
